## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle text by [不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA) Amoghavajra is the Tang re-translation of the same essential material as *[Wénshūshīlì fó tǔ yán jìng jīng 文殊師利佛土嚴淨經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0010)* (T0318, Western-Jìn version by Zhú Fǎhù). Where the older translation was 2 fascicles, Amoghavajra's Tang version is 3 fascicles, providing a fuller text. The work was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA) Amoghavajra's Cháng'ān translation activity, c. 746 – 774 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The Taishō text (T0319) is established on the standard apparatus.
